title: Remix NFT Collection
tagline: The remix NFT collection of Bored Ape Yacht Club and Mutant Ape Yacht Club
description: This project is a collection of NFTs from both the Bored Ape Yacht Club and the Mutant Ape Yacht Club. I have used both of them to make remix NFT collection for this project. These collected NFTs are uploaded on IPFS using Web3 storage. In addition, I have deployed on Rinkeby Testnet.
how_its_made: This project is built with the use of two different technologies. One is IPFS web3 storage which I used to store and upload NFTs using web3 storage API. Another one I used is NFT port API to mint and create collection. I have learnt to use this technologies from NFT port and web3 storage docs.
